validation_provenance.method: Independently derive all eight labels and each required-fact status from source/question/answer under the two neutral briefs; audit actor, action, object, scope, conditions, quantity, modality, temporal scope, ordered behavior overrides and composite separately. Then compare with supplied expectations and mechanically verify structure and reductions.
validation_provenance.isolation_limitations: Procedural isolation in a shared workspace, not a technical access barrier. The agent received operating/task instructions but read only the four listed files. Freeze commit and pre-execution custody are accepted as supplied without repository or provider verification. Agent review is not human adjudication, external assessment, or runtime holdout validation.
